sources.limitations: Public JSON camera metadata was retrieved. A supported API contract and image-reuse scope were not independently established; endpoint remains unset. Camera failures and delayed stills are possible.

sources.name: Calgary traffic camera inventory and images
sources.coverage: Major Calgary routes and selected intersections.
sources.update_frequency: Inventory metadata states daily updates; images are described as up-to-the-minute, with per-camera availability limits.
sources.license_notes: Dataset metadata points to City of Calgary Open Data Terms; follow the linked license and attribution requirements rather than assuming public domain.
sources.security_use: Corroborate traffic and access conditions around Calgary operating areas.
sources.limitations: Provider states footage is not recorded and cameras may be disabled for maintenance or to protect people involved in collisions. A missing image is not evidence of a clear road.

sources.name: Live Traffic NSW cameras
sources.coverage: New South Wales published traffic-camera sites.
sources.update_frequency: Periodic camera images and catalog updates; inspect per-image timestamps.
sources.license_notes: Official catalog lists Creative Commons Attribution. Preserve the feed rights object and verify current portal/login and image-specific conditions.
sources.security_use: Road-condition corroboration and travel planning in New South Wales.
sources.limitations: Camera URLs, locations and view descriptions are supplied. Catalog access does not establish continuous video, accurate pose or incident detection; portal resources may require login.

sources.name: Tallinn public intersection cameras
sources.coverage: Selected Tallinn intersections and corridors, Estonia.
sources.update_frequency: Camera-dependent public views; refresh cadence not established.
sources.license_notes: Public municipal viewing does not establish an open-data license, bulk collection or redistribution permission; confirm with the city.
sources.security_use: Corroborate visible road conditions at selected Tallinn intersections.
sources.limitations: Public site and camera categories reviewed; supported API, capture timing and reuse terms remain unresolved. The project uses curated camera locations and estimated poses.

sources.name: Tark Tee road cameras and travel conditions
sources.coverage: Estonian road network and published road-weather camera locations.
sources.update_frequency: Resource-specific updates; verify camera capture and road-event times.
sources.license_notes: Public service metadata is available, but full image and data-reuse terms were not established. Confirm current conditions through Transpordiamet or its national access point.
sources.security_use: Road-weather, visibility and disruption context for travel in Estonia.
sources.limitations: The cataloged ArcGIS service exposes queryable camera geography. The project uses separate DATEX backend routes; their support contract and image access were not independently validated.

sources.name: Warendorf municipal market-square webcam
sources.coverage: A single market-square view in Warendorf, Germany.
sources.update_frequency: Refresh timing not established in this review.
sources.license_notes: The municipal website links the webcam; independent image reuse and redistribution permission remain unverified.
sources.security_use: Limited visual context for the market square, subject to current provider access.
sources.limitations: Municipal webcam link verified, but camera health, timing, API support and image-reuse terms remain unresolved. The project uses an HTTP JPEG endpoint and an estimated pose.

sources.name: MBTA real-time transit feeds
sources.coverage: Greater Boston, Massachusetts, by supported mode.
sources.update_frequency: Operational real-time reports; exact per-feed cadence not independently verified.
sources.license_notes: MassDOT developer license governs use and attribution. Full agreement retrieval was blocked; confirm current redistribution and trademark conditions.
sources.security_use: Public-transit service continuity, route disruption and last-mile access planning.
sources.limitations: The project uses the public VehiclePositions feed. Documentation and license retrieval were incomplete; API availability is not certified. Vehicle positions are reports with age and coverage gaps; interpolation is not an additional measurement. Join identifiers to the matching static GTFS version.

sources.name: CapMetro real-time transit feeds
sources.coverage: Austin and the CapMetro service area, Texas.
sources.update_frequency: Operational vehicle, trip and service-alert updates; inspect message timestamps.
sources.license_notes: CapMetro grants limited, revocable use, reproduction and redistribution subject to its terms. Agency trademarks cannot be used in association with the data.
sources.security_use: Public-transit service continuity, route disruption and last-mile access planning.
sources.limitations: Texas open-data download is the vehicle-position resource used by the project; other resources cover trip updates and alerts. Vehicle positions are reports with age and coverage gaps; interpolation is not an additional measurement. Join identifiers to the matching static GTFS version.

sources.name: Metro Transit Twin Cities real-time feeds
sources.coverage: Minneapolis-Saint Paul service area, Minnesota.
sources.update_frequency: Provider documents GTFS-Realtime refresh every five seconds; individual observations can be older.
sources.license_notes: Public developer feeds are documented, but a complete reuse license for the real-time feed was not established. Do not transfer the companion static schedule dataset license automatically.
sources.security_use: Public-transit service continuity, route disruption and last-mile access planning.
sources.limitations: Includes documented vehicle, trip-update and service-alert feeds. Redistribution terms need confirmation. Vehicle positions are reports with age and coverage gaps; interpolation is not an additional measurement. Join identifiers to the matching static GTFS version.

sources.name: HSL Helsinki real-time transit feeds
sources.coverage: Helsinki region, Finland.
sources.update_frequency: Feed-specific real-time updates; use the documented update table and message timestamps.
sources.license_notes: HSL transit data is CC BY 4.0; credit HSL and delivery time. OSM-derived geometry uses separate ODbL terms.
sources.security_use: Public-transit service continuity, route disruption and last-mile access planning.
sources.limitations: Vehicle positions, trip updates and alerts have separate endpoints. Other Digitransit services can have different access requirements. Vehicle positions are reports with age and coverage gaps; interpolation is not an additional measurement. Join identifiers to the matching static GTFS version.

sources.name: OVapi Netherlands real-time transit feeds
sources.provider: Stichting OpenGeo / OVapi and contributing operators
sources.coverage: Netherlands; completeness varies by operator and mode.
sources.update_frequency: Real-time operator reports; use conditional requests when polling faster than once per minute.
sources.license_notes: Provider README permits use with no SLA and prohibits representing or impersonating transit agencies. Identify clients and follow compression/caching guidance.
sources.security_use: Public-transit service continuity, route disruption and last-mile access planning.
sources.limitations: Integrated feeds inherit upstream coverage gaps and matching issues. Vehicle positions are reports with age and coverage gaps; interpolation is not an additional measurement. Join identifiers to the matching static GTFS version.

sources.name: Entur Norway real-time transit feeds
sources.coverage: Included Norwegian public-transport operators.
sources.update_frequency: Reviewed documentation describes GTFS-Realtime dataset refresh every 15 seconds.
sources.license_notes: Most open APIs use NLOD; identify the application with ET-Client-Name. Privileged APIs have separate authorization requirements.
sources.security_use: Public-transit service continuity, route disruption and last-mile access planning.
sources.limitations: Developer documentation is migrating to developer.entur.no; confirm the current feed and policy before integration. Vehicle positions are reports with age and coverage gaps; interpolation is not an additional measurement. Join identifiers to the matching static GTFS version.

sources.name: Translink South East Queensland real-time transit
sources.coverage: South East Queensland, Australia.
sources.update_frequency: Operational GTFS-Realtime updates; timestamps and reporting vary by mode.
sources.license_notes: CC BY 4.0; provider states authentication is not required for these feeds.
sources.security_use: Public-transit service continuity, route disruption and last-mile access planning.
sources.limitations: SEQ vehicle positions, trip updates and alerts are separate resources. Do not infer coverage of all Queensland services. Vehicle positions are reports with age and coverage gaps; interpolation is not an additional measurement. Join identifiers to the matching static GTFS version.

sources.name: GBFS shared-mobility feed directory and station availability
sources.provider: Individual mobility operators / MobilityData GBFS directory
sources.coverage: Global directory; audited project configures 32 U.S. systems including Citi Bike, Divvy, Capital Bikeshare, Bay Wheels, BCycle and PBSC-hosted operators.
sources.update_frequency: Operator-specific station_status reports with last_updated and TTL; directory changes are separate.
sources.license_notes: GBFS is a specification, not a common license for every operator. Read each feed system_information license URL or license identifier and terms; commercial reuse is not presumed.
sources.security_use: Discover public station availability for alternative transport and last-mile continuity.
sources.limitations: Directory entry and schema compatibility do not establish active service, feed health or individual rider movement. All 32 configured systems were inventoried, not individually integration-tested; see the project-source audit.

sources.name: Radio Browser station directory
sources.coverage: Worldwide submitted internet-radio stations; geolocation and coverage are uneven.
sources.update_frequency: Community directory and automated stream checks; broadcaster programming is independent.
sources.license_notes: API documentation permits public use and mirroring. Verify the current directory license separately; each broadcaster controls rights to its audio.
sources.security_use: Discover local broadcasters for human review and corroboration of public reporting.
sources.limitations: Station coordinates and tags do not establish a current local-news program or verified incident. Discover an API mirror per the docs; directory access grants no recording or redistribution rights to broadcasts.

sources.name: Google News locality and topic RSS discovery
sources.coverage: International indexed news; language, outlet selection and place matching vary.
sources.update_frequency: Indexing-dependent; article publication and event occurrence can differ substantially.
sources.license_notes: Reviewed Google News terms restrict use to personal, noncommercial purposes; publishers retain rights to their articles. Confirm permitted use rather than treating RSS access as redistribution permission.
sources.security_use: Discover locality-matched reporting for manual verification and event corroboration.
sources.limitations: The project constructs RSS search URLs, but a supported public API contract was not established. Matches are news references, not validated incident locations or severity assessments.

sources.name: Google Maps imagery, 3D tiles and place context
sources.coverage: Global mapping with product-dependent 3D, imagery and Places coverage.
sources.update_frequency: Provider-managed imagery and map updates; capture dates vary by location and product.
sources.license_notes: API key, billing and product-specific terms apply. Preserve attribution and review storage, caching, redistribution and derived-data restrictions; documentation license does not license map content.
sources.security_use: Visual geographic context, geocoding and place discovery around authorized operating areas.
sources.limitations: Photorealistic 3D is a textured mesh, not live satellite video. Geocoding, Places and Street View are separate products; appearance or a place-search match does not verify present activity.

sources.name: Esri World Imagery basemap
sources.coverage: Worldwide imagery mosaic; resolution and acquisition age vary.
sources.update_frequency: Mosaic updates by region; imagery acquisition date is not the tile request time.
sources.license_notes: Esri and contributor terms apply with required source credit. Public access to the classic service does not grant unlimited commercial usage, bulk downloads or redistribution rights.
sources.security_use: Imagery context for facilities, routes and geographic interpretation.
sources.limitations: Static aerial/satellite imagery may be old and has mixed spatial resolution. Service metadata was inspected; plan entitlements and offline-use rights were not validated.

sources.name: Cesium ion global terrain and hosted content
sources.coverage: Global terrain with source-dependent detail; hosted imagery and 3D assets have separate coverage.
sources.update_frequency: Provider-curated terrain releases; not a live terrain-change feed.
sources.license_notes: ion account/token and plan terms govern access; source credits and third-party asset terms apply. Verify commercial eligibility and quotas independently.
sources.security_use: Terrain context, elevation-aware display and preliminary line-of-sight exploration.
sources.limitations: Terrain meshes are generalized representations, not a survey or guaranteed clearance model. ion hosting does not transfer rights to Google or other third-party content.

sources.name: Re:Earth Terrain elevation and mesh service
sources.provider: Eukarya / Re:Earth / Mapterhorn and credited elevation providers
sources.coverage: Global terrain product with heterogeneous source resolution.
sources.update_frequency: Source/product release dependent; no live elevation-update promise established.
sources.license_notes: Mapterhorn DEM: CC BY 4.0; EGM2008 geoid: public domain; optional Protomaps/OSM water mask: ODbL. Retain required credits. Hosted service is keyless and best-effort, with possible rate limits and no SLA.
sources.security_use: Elevation context and terrain placement in situational-awareness maps.
sources.limitations: The documented endpoint supplies ellipsoidal heights; sea-level and geoid products differ. Terrain is generalized, not a survey or clearance guarantee. The project also calls /heights.json, whose separate API contract was not established here.

sources.name: Photon OpenStreetMap geocoding
sources.coverage: Global OSM-derived place search and reverse geocoding.
sources.update_frequency: OSM-derived index updates; search results are geographic context rather than events.
sources.license_notes: Underlying OSM data is ODbL. Public instance is fair-use, can throttle extensive use, and offers no availability guarantee; self-host or arrange capacity for sustained workloads.
sources.security_use: Resolve place mentions and label operating-area coordinates.
sources.limitations: Ambiguous names and incomplete OSM addresses require disambiguation. Public search access is not an unrestricted bulk-geocoding entitlement.

sources.name: Nominatim OpenStreetMap geocoding
sources.coverage: Global OSM-derived addresses and named places; completeness varies.
sources.update_frequency: OSM-derived index updates; inspect returned geometry and place identity.
sources.license_notes: ODbL data attribution and applicable share-alike terms. Public service policy requires identified clients, caching and at most one request/second across the application; bulk/systematic queries and autocomplete are restricted.
sources.security_use: Occasional place resolution and reverse-geocoded location context within permitted use.
sources.limitations: Read the linked usage policy before choosing the hosted endpoint. Public capacity is limited; this is not a default backend for generic no-code geocoding or recurring bulk enrichment. Self-hosted or contracted services have separate policies.

sources.name: FOSSGIS OpenStreetMap routing service
sources.coverage: OSM-covered road, cycling and walking networks; profile and regional completeness vary.
sources.update_frequency: Routes computed on request from processed map data; not a live road-closure service.
sources.license_notes: ODbL-derived data plus FOSSGIS hosted-service policy. Attribution, a fix-the-map link and identified clients are required; maximum one request/second, no scraping or heavy use, and commercial restrictions apply.
sources.security_use: Preliminary route alternatives for travel and site-access planning.
sources.limitations: Routing does not prove current passability, legal access or emergency suitability. Use provider documentation for current car/bike/foot endpoints and arrange self-hosting or licensed capacity for sustained use.

sources.name: TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map
sources.coverage: Global mapped submarine cable systems and landing points.
sources.update_frequency: Editorial updates; bundled project extracts are dated snapshots.
sources.license_notes: The audited project labels its bundled extract CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Current publisher licensing and commercial structured-data access must be confirmed independently; do not assume the code license covers cable data.
sources.security_use: Connectivity dependency and geographic cable-landing context.
sources.limitations: Map lines are schematic context, not precise engineering routes or cable-outage observations. Publisher site rendered insufficient text for a full license review.

sources.name: Natural Earth physical and cultural map data
sources.coverage: Global small-scale cartography at 1:10m, 1:50m and 1:110m.
sources.update_frequency: Versioned releases; review the source release and processing date.
sources.license_notes: Provider places raster and vector data in the public domain; attribution is appreciated but not required.
sources.security_use: Regional names, land/marine boundaries and general geographic context.
sources.limitations: Cartographic generalization is unsuitable for parcel, legal boundary or facility-scale decisions. Project copies are simplified snapshots, not live boundary observations.

sources.name: DataSF Analysis Neighborhoods
sources.provider: City and County of San Francisco / DataSF
sources.coverage: San Francisco analysis-neighborhood polygons.
sources.update_frequency: Administrative dataset revisions; no live update cadence established.
sources.license_notes: The upstream project records PDDL 1.0 for its source snapshot; current provider metadata could not be independently retrieved due to TLS/retrieval errors. Confirm before redistribution.
sources.security_use: Consistent neighborhood aggregation and locality labels for San Francisco reporting.
sources.limitations: Analysis areas are not proof of colloquial, legal or operational boundaries. Preserve source version; project polygons were simplified. Endpoint is not promoted until current documentation is verified.

sources.name: Open Infrastructure Map
sources.coverage: Global community-mapped infrastructure; completeness varies substantially.
sources.update_frequency: Map processing of community edits; inspect extract age and underlying OSM features.
sources.license_notes: Underlying OSM data is ODbL; additional analysis and regional layers have their own credits. Commercial GIS exports are offered separately by Infrageomatics.
sources.security_use: Discover mapped power, communications and other infrastructure for further verification.
sources.limitations: No guaranteed facility completeness, operational status, capacity or outage detection. Provider recommends Overpass for small extracts and raw OSM processing for large ones.

sources.name: Vantor Open Data Program disaster imagery
sources.coverage: Selected major disaster activations worldwide; event footprints and acquisition dates vary.
sources.update_frequency: Event-triggered selected before/after image releases; not continuous global observation.
sources.license_notes: Provider identifies Creative Commons BY-NC 4.0 for Open Data Program imagery. Preserve attribution and noncommercial restrictions; confirm each activation and obtain separate permission for incompatible uses.
sources.security_use: Compare disaster-area imagery for situational awareness and humanitarian impact assessment within permitted use.
sources.limitations: Clouds, acquisition timing and selective activation constrain coverage. The project bundles two dated Nepal-event image crops; those are not a live imagery feed. Visual change alone does not establish damage cause or severity.
